gbm_population_evidence.quote: Pathologically confirmed diagnosis of glioblastoma of the cerebrum.
Gliosarcoma, anaplastic astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, ependymoma, low grade glioma or any histology other than glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: Peptide Vaccine (SurVaxM) in emulsion with Montanide given together with locally administered Sargramostim plus adjuvant oral Temozolomide
Patients in this group will also receive a second separate injection of a drug called sargramostim that boosts the patient's immune system at the site of the first injection.

candidate_flag.reason: Sargramostim (licensed GM-CSF) is given only in the vaccine arm as a local immune adjuvant; coded as part of the vaccine regimen, but it could be read as an investigational pharmacological candidate, which would change S6.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: stimulates immune responses capable of killing cancer cells that express the survivin molecule

agents.drug_class_hint: GM-CSF, used as local vaccine immune adjuvant

flag.reason: Vaccine adjuvant given only in vaccine arm; could alternatively be a pharmacological candidate (experimental_monotherapy).

role_evidence.quote: an injection under the skin of SurVaxM in Montanide (a milky white substance that helps SurVaxM to be recognized by the patient's immune system)

The main purpose of this study is to determine whether adding SurVaxM to standard-of-care temozolomide chemotherapy is better than temozolomide treatment alone for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

source_quote.quote: To evaluate the molecular predictors of response to SurVaxM, including MGMT methylation status, anti-surviving immunoglobin titers, surviving-specific CD8+ responses, tumor survivin expression levels and other molecular tumor tissue markers
The result of tumor IDH-1 mutation test must be available.

coder_notes: Arm A is registered as ACTIVE_COMPARATOR but is the vaccine (experimental) arm; Arm B is the placebo comparator. MGMT and IDH test results must be available at entry but no status is required, so not coded as eligibility biomarkers. Montanide is not a registered intervention but is given in both arms as vaccine emulsion; listed for transparency. Vaccine immune responses (anti-survivin titres, CD8+ responses) are planned but relate to the vaccine, not a pharmacological candidate, so target_engagement coded no.
